changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: UPDATE member m SET is_provider = (m.removed IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subsystem ss JOIN service s ON s.subsystem_id = ss.id WHERE ss.member_id = m.id AND ss.removed IS NULL AND s.removed IS NULL))

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: UPDATE service s SET service_type = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wsdl w WHERE w.service_id = s.id AND w.removed IS NULL) THEN 'SOAP' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_api o WHERE o.service_id = s.id AND o.removed IS NULL) THEN 'OPENAPI' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rest r WHERE r.service_id = s.id AND r.removed IS NULL) THEN 'REST' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END
